== Biography ==
Isabell Glasgow was baptised at Cavers in December 1694, daughter of a William Glasgow.

== Research Notes ==
=== Working father replacement, 22 October 2026 ===

The preferred working father is [[Glasgow-4138|William Glasgow]], probable 76%, replacing [[Glasgow-1605]] as the selected local father. The Polwarth child is retained as a possible 38% alternative. Prefer William Glasgow-4138, documented at Cavers and Ormistoun in 1679–84, as the William who fathered Isabell at Cavers in December 1694. The repeated full name, same parish association, earlier adult activity and feasible father generation give this record-defined local adult a stronger fit than identifying the father directly with the 1658 Polwarth child Glasgow-1605. This is an inferred identification across the held records, not an explicit father-daughter statement in the Covenanter material.

Probable 76% for the complete father-profile identification. The baptism names William but supplies no mother. No shared relative, precise abode, occupation or continuous identifying clause connects the Cavers baptism to the 1679–84 servant. The Polwarth child remains a possible 38% alternative and might itself be the Cavers adult; no identity merge is selected. Other local Williams remain possible. The two FreeREG transcriptions disagree between 2 and 8 December 1694; the parish index gives 2 December. No new source inspection, birth age, mother, migration or live WikiTree change is claimed.

Next useful test: Compare the original Cavers baptism and Ormistoun entries for residence, occupation, witnesses or a relative joining the named father to the documented servant.

Held source basis: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-3370 FreeREG, Isabell Glasgow baptism transcription, Cavers, 2 December 1694.]; [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-3370 FreeREG record 0427, Isabell Glasgow baptism transcription, Cavers, 8 December 1694.]; [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=GBPR%2FCOVENANT%2F028558&tab=this Cavers William, examination June 1679, servant at Ormistoun: reviewed Findmypast transcript JC39/22]; [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=GBPR%2FCOVENANT%2F028560&tab=this William Glasgow, Ormistoun servant list, October 1684; Findmypast Scottish Covenanters, record GBPR/COVENANT/028560].



Two FreeREG transcriptions disagree on the day: one gives 2 December 1694, while record 0427 gives 8 December and inconsistently reports Cavers both as an abode and as “No abode given.” The structured date uses 2 December only as an uncertain working date pending the original register.

The entries name the father only as William Glasgow. They do not identify him with [[Glasgow-1605|William Glasgow]], so the former attachment to that Polwarth child remains an uncertain alternative rather than the selected local father.

A FamilySearch index previously cited for this profile is preserved as a derivative lead.<ref>“Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564–1950,” FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VQH7-5PY : accessed 16 September 2021), Isabell Glasgow, 1694.</ref>
